openings.claim: Common allowance may cause size-dependent mismatch.
openings.discriminator: Consistent residuals despite accurate production support allowance error; operator/direction variation weakens it.
openings.probe: Stage small/medium/large covers before remaining cuts; log target, cut and finished dimensions, design, direction, operator, adjustments and labor. Wash offcuts in both directions.
openings.uncertainty: Cause, width shrinkage and calibration transfer unknown.

openings.claim: Customer dimensions and corner geometry may independently defeat reference-table acceptance.
openings.discriminator: Local corner interference versus overall length/width mismatch.
openings.probe: Obtain dimensions and corner profiles from six customers before cutting; prioritize four nominal-only orders where possible. Compare reference geometry and observe uncoached first placement.
openings.uncertainty: Customer coverage and timely measurements unconfirmed.

openings.claim: Geometry-linked cards plus staged allowance calibration may interact to improve fit.
openings.discriminator: Geometry correction improves fit more with calibrated than common allowances.
openings.probe: Cross reference/measured geometry with common/calibrated allowances in matched offcut mockups; record mismatch, seating attempts and time, then stage actual covers.
openings.uncertainty: Mockups only screen interaction; pattern transfer and labor savings unproven.

decision: Probe before releasing remaining cuts. Preserve ordered sizes/designs and purchased stock; verify five-cycle durability, tool-free removal, existing two machines, cost <=350 and completion within three weeks. Measure waste by area <=8%; prior weight estimate is insufficient. Count all cooperative labor: require >=38/40 specified-table first-placement fits, every ordered design and median <=32 minutes. Unresolved geometry prevents claiming success.
